X: 1

function: read dynamic { result: X }
function: middle X:n { result: [read dynamic] }
function: nearest frame {
 X: 7
 result: [middle 9]
}
output [nearest frame] named "nearest dynamic frame"

function: assign in frame {
 X: 2
 if 1 { X: 3 }
 loop I over {4} { X: X + I }
 result: X
}
output [assign in frame] named "function assignment"
output X named "caller binding"

function: descend N:n {
 if N { result: [descend N - 1] }
 result: X
}
function: recursive caller {
 X: 7
 result: [descend 2]
}
output [recursive caller] named "recursive dynamic binding"

\\\ Result \\\

"nearest dynamic frame",9,0,9,9
#,%

"function assignment",7,0,7,7
#,%
7,100

"caller binding",1,0,1,1
#,%
1,100

"recursive dynamic binding",7,0,7,7
#,%
